flows.name: Agent Registration
flows.purpose: Acceptance story for registering a curated ClawHouse agent: official onboarding boundary, key market creation, ledger board setup, and the unfinished public profile handoff.

steps.name: IronClaw Creator Onboarding
steps.description: The creator should start from the official IronClaw onboarding and produce a ClawHouse-approved agent package. 未完成: The repo truth says official onboarding is IronClaw-side; production hosting, installer, and signature verification are not implemented in this Workbench yet.
steps.pendingReason: The repo truth says official onboarding is IronClaw-side; production hosting, installer, and signature verification are not implemented in this Workbench yet.
runningNotes: 未完成: The repo truth says official onboarding is IronClaw-side; production hosting, installer, and signature verification are not implemented in this Workbench yet.

steps.name: Bind Agent Wallet Metadata
steps.description: The approved agent should expose public wallet metadata that ClawHouse can store without private key material. 未完成: Only the local developer wallet tool exists here. The official IronClaw wallet binding and production metadata handoff are not implemented yet.
steps.pendingReason: Only the local developer wallet tool exists here. The official IronClaw wallet binding and production metadata handoff are not implemented yet.
runningNotes: 未完成: Only the local developer wallet tool exists here. The official IronClaw wallet binding and production metadata handoff are not implemented yet.

steps.name: Create Agent Key Market
steps.description: Creates a real NEAR testnet key market for the approved agent. Change agentId before sending if the market already exists.
runningNotes: Checking NEAR testnet to see whether this agent key market already exists.
If it is new, signing a create transaction with the test user account.
Broadcasting the transaction to NEAR testnet and waiting for the raw outcome.
Extracting txHash and the created market state from the transaction result.

steps.name: GET /health
steps.description: Checks that the local Agent Board Ledger backend is reachable before registering the agent board.
runningNotes: Calling the real Agent Board Ledger /health endpoint.
Use this first to confirm the local backend is running and connected to Neon/Postgres.

steps.name: Register Agent Board
steps.description: Registers the approved agent in Agent Board Ledger so the agent has a board id, wallet metadata, and a starting value for later trade reporting.
runningNotes: Calling the real POST /boards backend API.
ledgerAuthorizationHeader must be formatted as Bearer <AGENT_BOARD_LEDGER_ADMIN_TOKEN>.
Leave ledgerBoardId empty if you want the backend to generate an id.
The returned board id is stored as ledgerBoardId for the later API calls.

steps.name: Verify Agent Board
steps.description: Reads the registered board back by id to confirm the user-facing agent board record exists.
runningNotes: Reading a board through the real GET /boards/:id API.
Public boards do not need a read token; holder-gated boards need ledgerReadToken.

steps.name: Verify Initial Key Price
steps.description: Reads the first buy quote after market creation so a PM can see the market is priceable before users buy.
runningNotes: Calling a NEAR view method through the local quote script.
No private key, gas, or transaction is used for this quote.
Calculating the bonding-curve price, fees, and max buy cost.

steps.name: Publish Public Agent Profile
steps.description: The registered agent should appear as a user-facing profile with market price, board summary, and metadata. 未完成: The public ClawHouse agent profile/listing surface is not implemented in this repo yet.
steps.pendingReason: The public ClawHouse agent profile/listing surface is not implemented in this repo yet.
runningNotes: 未完成: The public ClawHouse agent profile/listing surface is not implemented in this repo yet.

flows.name: User Browses Agent
flows.purpose: Acceptance story for a public user discovering an agent and reading the public board, price, timeline, and performance evidence that currently exists.

steps.name: Open Agent Discovery List
steps.description: A user should be able to open a ClawHouse discovery list and pick a curated agent. 未完成: The user-facing discovery/listing page and API are not implemented yet.
steps.pendingReason: The user-facing discovery/listing page and API are not implemented yet.
runningNotes: 未完成: The user-facing discovery/listing page and API are not implemented yet.

steps.name: Read Agent Board
steps.description: Reads the selected agent board through the real Ledger API. Public boards should return without a read token.
runningNotes: Reading a board through the real GET /boards/:id API.
Public boards do not need a read token; holder-gated boards need ledgerReadToken.

steps.name: Read Agent Timeline
steps.description: Reads the board event timeline that a browsing user would inspect before deciding whether to buy a key.
runningNotes: Reading the event timeline through the real GET /boards/:id/events API.
Public boards do not need a read token; holder-gated boards need ledgerReadToken.

steps.name: Read Portfolio Snapshot
steps.description: Reads the latest public or token-gated portfolio snapshot for the selected agent board.
runningNotes: Reading the latest portfolio snapshot through the real GET /boards/:id/portfolio API.

steps.name: Read PnL Snapshot
steps.description: Reads the latest PnL snapshot so a browsing user can evaluate performance evidence.
runningNotes: Reading the latest PnL snapshot through the real GET /boards/:id/pnl API.

steps.name: Read Price Evidence
steps.description: Reads stored price evidence that supports the agent board performance calculation.
runningNotes: Reading price snapshots through the real GET /boards/:id/prices API.

steps.name: Preview Key Buy Cost
steps.description: Shows the live bonding-curve quote a user would see before deciding to buy a key.
runningNotes: Calling a NEAR view method through the local quote script.
No private key, gas, or transaction is used for this quote.
Calculating the bonding-curve price, fees, and max buy cost.

steps.name: Render Share Card
steps.description: A user should be able to share a receipt-style card for the agent or market moment. 未完成: Receipt/share-card rendering is not implemented yet.
steps.pendingReason: Receipt/share-card rendering is not implemented yet.
runningNotes: 未完成: Receipt/share-card rendering is not implemented yet.

flows.name: User Buys Key
flows.purpose: Acceptance story for a user quoting a key, buying it through a real NEAR testnet transaction, and using the result to unlock holder-facing reads where implemented.

steps.name: Quote Buy Price
steps.description: Gets the current bonding-curve cost, fees, and max-price guard before the user signs a buy transaction.
runningNotes: Calling a NEAR view method through the local quote script.
No private key, gas, or transaction is used for this quote.
Calculating the bonding-curve price, fees, and max buy cost.

steps.name: Buy Key On NEAR
steps.description: Sends a real NEAR testnet buy_key transaction using the configured test user account and private key.
runningNotes: Using the previous quote as max_price protection.
Signing a buy transaction with the test user account.
Attaching NEAR for the key price, fees, and storage deposit.
Waiting for NEAR testnet to return the raw transaction outcome and txHash.

steps.name: Verify Holder Balance
steps.description: Reads NEAR contract state after the buy to confirm supply, reserve, and the buyer holder balance.
runningNotes: Calling NEAR RPC view state directly; this does not sign or send a transaction.
Reading the agent market state and holder balance after the buy.
Extracting supply, reserve, and holder balance for comparison.

steps.name: Create Holder Read Token
steps.description: Creates a service-authorized read-access check and optional read token that can be used for holder-gated Ledger readback.
runningNotes: Calling the service-authorized read-access check API.
Use this to issue a read token for holder-gated board readback.

steps.name: Read Board With Token
steps.description: Reads the agent board using the read token created for the buyer where the board is holder-gated.
runningNotes: Reading a board through the real GET /boards/:id API.
Public boards do not need a read token; holder-gated boards need ledgerReadToken.

steps.name: Read Holder Timeline
steps.description: Reads the event timeline after key purchase to verify the holder can inspect agent evidence.
runningNotes: Reading the event timeline through the real GET /boards/:id/events API.
Public boards do not need a read token; holder-gated boards need ledgerReadToken.

steps.name: Read Holder Portfolio
steps.description: Reads the latest portfolio snapshot as the holder-facing detail view.
runningNotes: Reading the latest portfolio snapshot through the real GET /boards/:id/portfolio API.

steps.name: Read Holder PnL
steps.description: Reads the latest PnL snapshot as the holder-facing performance view.
runningNotes: Reading the latest PnL snapshot through the real GET /boards/:id/pnl API.

steps.name: Live Holder Gate From Key Balance
steps.description: The product should grant holder detail access directly from the live NEAR key balance after purchase. 未完成: Current Ledger read tokens are service-authorized acceptance records; full production holder gating against the live key market is not complete.

flows.name: Agent Reports Trade
flows.purpose: Acceptance story for an agent writing trade/accounting evidence into Agent Board Ledger and users reading the reconciled timeline, portfolio, and PnL.

steps.name: IronClaw Auto-Signed Trade Report
steps.description: The production agent runtime should automatically sign and submit trade events after real agent activity. 未完成: The automatic IronClaw runtime-to-Ledger reporting path is not implemented here; use the script-backed signed flow or explicit API steps below for acceptance.
steps.pendingReason: The automatic IronClaw runtime-to-Ledger reporting path is not implemented here; use the script-backed signed flow or explicit API steps below for acceptance.
runningNotes: 未完成: The automatic IronClaw runtime-to-Ledger reporting path is not implemented here; use the script-backed signed flow or explicit API steps below for acceptance.

steps.name: Run Signed Report Flow
steps.description: Runs the real local signed Ledger flow: wallet setup, board registration, signed event and attachment, observation, cron, event readback, portfolio, and PnL.
runningNotes: Calling the real local Agent Board Ledger service; the step fails if the service is not running.
The Ledger service must be started with AGENT_BOARD_LEDGER_ADMIN_TOKEN matching ledgerAdminToken.
Creating or reusing a local Workbench wallet artifact under work/ and registering a board with its public wallet metadata.
Signing the event and attachment requests with the board wallet before sending them to the Ledger HTTP API.
Passing ledgerAdminToken through the Workbench script environment, not through command-line arguments.
Writing a service-authorized wallet observation, running service-authorized cron reconciliation, then reading events, portfolio, and PnL back from the Ledger.

steps.name: Write Wallet Observation
steps.description: Writes service-authorized wallet observation evidence for a board through the real Ledger API.
runningNotes: Calling the real service-authorized observation API.
This is how the backend records an observed wallet/portfolio state before cron calculates PnL.
ledgerAuthorizationHeader must be formatted as Bearer <AGENT_BOARD_LEDGER_ADMIN_TOKEN>.

steps.name: Write Price Evidence
steps.description: Writes explicit price evidence that later PnL snapshots can reference.
runningNotes: Calling the real price snapshot API.
Use this before cron when you want a PnL snapshot to link to explicit pricing evidence.

steps.name: Write Balance Change
steps.description: Writes service-authorized balance-change evidence for a trade or accounting event.
runningNotes: Calling the real balance-change API.
This records accounting evidence for the wallet and can link back to an observation, tx hash, or intent id.

steps.name: Reconcile Ledger
steps.description: Runs the real cron reconciliation endpoint so observations and accounting evidence become events, snapshots, and PnL.
runningNotes: Calling the real cron reconciliation API.
This links observed activity to events, creates holding snapshots, and calculates PnL.

steps.name: Verify Timeline Event
steps.description: Reads the event timeline after reporting and reconciliation to confirm the user-visible event exists.
runningNotes: Reading the event timeline through the real GET /boards/:id/events API.
Public boards do not need a read token; holder-gated boards need ledgerReadToken.

steps.name: Verify Portfolio Snapshot
steps.description: Reads the latest portfolio snapshot produced from the reported evidence.
runningNotes: Reading the latest portfolio snapshot through the real GET /boards/:id/portfolio API.

steps.name: Verify PnL Snapshot
steps.description: Reads the latest PnL snapshot produced from the reported evidence.
runningNotes: Reading the latest PnL snapshot through the real GET /boards/:id/pnl API.

flows.name: User Sells Key
flows.purpose: Acceptance story for a key holder quoting a sell, selling through a real NEAR transaction, and verifying the post-sale state and unfinished access revocation boundary.

steps.name: Quote Sell Payout
steps.description: Gets the current sell payout and min-payout guard before the user signs a sell transaction.
runningNotes: Calling a NEAR view method through the local quote script.
No private key, gas, or transaction is used for this quote.
Calculating the expected sell payout and min_payout guard.

steps.name: Sell Key On NEAR
steps.description: Sends a real NEAR testnet sell_key transaction using the configured test user account and previous sell quote.
runningNotes: Using the previous quote as min_payout protection.
Signing a sell transaction with the test user account.
Broadcasting the sell to NEAR testnet and waiting for the raw outcome.
Extracting txHash, updated supply, holder balance, and reserve.

steps.name: Verify Post-Sale Contract State
steps.description: Reads NEAR contract state after the sell to confirm supply, reserve, and the seller holder balance.
runningNotes: Calling NEAR RPC view state directly; this does not sign or send a transaction.
Reading the agent market state and holder balance after the buy.
Extracting supply, reserve, and holder balance for comparison.

steps.name: Record Access Check After Sell
steps.description: Creates a service-authorized read-access check that can be set to denied when validating post-sale access behavior.
runningNotes: Calling the service-authorized read-access check API.
Use this to issue a read token for holder-gated board readback.

steps.name: Automatically Revoke Holder Access

flows.name: Developer Setup & Edge Cases
flows.purpose: Acceptance story for developer-only setup, local wallet artifact safety, raw API templates, migrations, and script-backed regression checks.

steps.name: Check Ledger Service
steps.description: Calls the Ledger health endpoint before running setup or edge-case scripts.
runningNotes: Calling the real Agent Board Ledger /health endpoint.
Use this first to confirm the local backend is running and connected to Neon/Postgres.

steps.name: Migrate Ledger Schema
steps.description: Runs the real Neon migration script for Agent Board Ledger schema setup.
runningNotes: Uses the editable ledgerDatabaseUrl input as an environment variable; the database URL is not placed in command-line arguments.
Creates or updates the Neon Postgres schema for boards, events, observations, accounting snapshots, read access checks, and audit events.
Returns a redacted connection string, table list, and small row-count health check.

steps.name: Generate Local Test Wallet
steps.description: Generates a local test wallet artifact for development acceptance and returns only public metadata.
runningNotes: Running the allowlisted local NEAR wallet generator.
Writing the generated test wallet artifact under work/acceptance-workbench.
Returning only public wallet metadata to the Workbench response.

steps.name: Inspect Local Wallet Public Metadata
steps.description: Reads the local wallet artifact through the public inspect path and verifies private key material is not returned.
runningNotes: Reading the generated wallet artifact through the local wallet tool.
Requesting the public inspect view only.
Extracting walletAddress, publicKey, and keyId for later checks.

steps.name: Verify Wallet Overwrite Refusal
steps.description: Attempts duplicate wallet generation without overwrite and expects the local tool to refuse replacing the artifact.
runningNotes: Running the same generator against the existing wallet artifact.
Expecting the tool to refuse overwrite with exit code 1 and output that mentions overwrite.
Confirming the refusal text is visible without private key material.

steps.name: Inspect Wallet After Refusal
steps.description: Reads the wallet artifact after overwrite refusal to confirm public metadata is still available and private key material is still hidden.
runningNotes: Reading the wallet artifact after the duplicate-generation refusal.
Checking that the artifact still exposes the same public metadata.
If privateKey or secretKey appears as a redacted field, the public inspect path still leaked a private field name.

steps.name: Raw Signed Event Endpoint
steps.description: Exposes the real wallet-signed event endpoint for developers who provide matching signature headers manually.
runningNotes: This exposes the raw wallet-signed event API.
The backend will reject this request unless the signature headers match the exact request body.
Use the signed script flow when you want Workbench to generate the wallet signature automatically.

inputs.ledgerReason: Raw API event submitted from Workbench.

The Ledger service must be started with AGENT_BOARD_LEDGER_ADMIN_TOKEN matching ledgerAdminToken.
Creating or reusing a local Workbench wallet artifact under work/ and registering a board with its public wallet metadata.
Signing the event and attachment requests with the board wallet before sending them to the Ledger HTTP API.

Writing a service-authorized wallet observation, running service-authorized cron reconciliation, then reading events, portfolio, and PnL back from the Ledger.

steps.name: Run Ledger Edge Cases
steps.description: Runs the script-backed edge-case suite against the real local Ledger service.
runningNotes: Calling the real local Agent Board Ledger service; the step fails if the service is not running.
The Ledger service must be started with AGENT_BOARD_LEDGER_ADMIN_TOKEN matching ledgerAdminToken.
Using the editable ledgerAdminToken input through the script environment, not through command-line arguments.
Verifying unauthenticated observations and future observed_at values are rejected through HTTP.

Writing price snapshots and balance changes through service-authorized API calls.
Verifying signed event creation, signed attachments, service-authorized observations, cron reconciliation, and PnL readback still work.
Verifying PnL links to the accepted price snapshot.
Running cron twice and failing if the second tick creates duplicate snapshots or advances freshness without new observations.
